title: roota
tagline: roota is a crypto currency DEX aggregator. Find the best rate to swap your cryptos!
description: Roota aggregates many different liquidity providers to give you the best rate to swap your crypto. No more going on 3 different DEX to find out who gives you the best deal. Routa aggregates them all and splits your order to reduce slippage and fees! Routa doesn't charge you any fees!
how_its_made:
The project uses metamask and walletconnect for browser wallet connection.
It uses svelte and web3 js for the interactions with the blockchains.
The main focus has been to find bridges between Optimism and Polygon, for that different liquidity sources have been used (across.to, mulitchain.router, hyphen-biconomy).
